entities.name: Max Fürbringer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Max Carl Anton Fürbringer was a German anatomist, known for his anatomical investigations of vertebrates and especially for his studies in ornithology on avian morphology and classification. He was responsible for the first major phylogenetic ordering of bird groups based on a large scale study on a combination of skeletal, morphological and anatomical characteristics.
